title: Kissed by Fire Mediterranean Rest-Meat Tagliere
description: A charred, velvety, and flavorful Mediterranean dish featuring rest-meat, perfect for a midnight craving
instructions: Prepare the rest-meat by slicing it into thin strips and seasoning with chilli powder, coarse black pepper, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the rest-meat strips for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until charred and cooked to your liking.
Remove the rest-meat from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add caramelized onions and roasted red bell peppers to the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are heated through.
Add the kalamata olives and artichoke hearts to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
To assemble the tagliere, place the rest-meat strips on a large platter or individual plates.
Top the rest-meat with the vegetable mixture and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
If using feta cheese, crumble it over the top of the tagliere.
Note: To caramelize the onions and roast the red bell peppers, cook them in a skillet over low heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are deep brown and sweet.
